purpose: Compare two ledgers that differ only in the position-size target: constant state vs EWMA state from state-vol-v1 stored forecasts. Same deposits, costs, rule mechanics, periods. Descriptive comparison; no profit claim; no live orders.

state_results.use: forecast_records: h_forecast.reference and h_forecast.ewma looked up by decision_session only; no recomputation of h

raw_prices.fields: O, C unadjusted won; 5938 session days 2002-10-14..2026-11-05; day list identical to the adjusted series used by the state module (checked 2026-11-06)

ladder_results.use: consistency anchor: variant A must reproduce R1_buyhold exactly on common / bull_2025 / crash_2026

price_convention: Ledger uses raw unadjusted O/C in won (integer shares, real fees). State h comes from adjusted log returns (distribution-adjusted). Mixing is declared: h is a variance state, not a price; dividends paid in cash are not modelled in the ledger (same as ladder v2).

A_const_state.w_i: min(1, sqrt(h_ref / h_ref)) = 1 for every decision session
A_const_state.note: identical to ladder R1_buyhold by construction (buy max whole shares when cash allows, never sell)

B_ewma_state.h_ewma_i: forecast_records entry with decision_session == days[i] (its predicted_for_session == days[i+1]); information through session i only
B_ewma_state.h_ref: constant_calibration_second_moment h from the state envelope (2.1990e-04, sd 1.48%/day)
B_ewma_state.note: target volatility equals the calibration unconditional sd by construction; no new free parameter; de-risks only (w<1 when forecast sd exceeds 1.48%/day), never leverages

only_difference_between_variants: the number w_i used in target_qty; everything else byte-identical code path

mechanics.deposit: 10,000 won added at the start of every session in the period, including the last
mechanics.decision: at close of session i compute w_i from the state record with decision_session == days[i]
mechanics.execution: at open of session i+1: buy price O[i+1]+5, sell price O[i+1]-5, fee floor(0.015% x notional) won per side, no tax (KR ETF)
mechanics.valuation_for_target: W = cash + qty x O[i+1] (open, no tick); target_qty = floor(w_i x W / O[i+1])
mechanics.sell_rule: if target_qty < qty: sell (qty - target_qty) shares at O[i+1]-5 minus fee
mechanics.buy_rule: if target_qty > qty: buy min(target_qty - qty, largest q with q x (O[i+1]+5) + fee <= cash) shares
mechanics.no_trade_band: none beyond integer flooring (simplest axis first); churn is measured, a band is a later rung if needed
mechanics.mark: value at close of i+1 = cash + qty x C[i+1]; last session of period: deposit then mark at close i, no trade
mechanics.pnl: value - cumulative deposits; max drawdown on (value - deposits) with running peak starting at 0 (ladder convention)
mechanics.exposure: qty x C / value per marked session
mechanics.missing_state_record: abort run with availability_status=invalid_input; periods below are chosen so every decision session has a record

periods.note: each period ledger starts from zero cash and zero shares; state_eval starts at the first decision session that has a forecast record (2014-12-30 -> 2015-01-02)

paired: B minus A of (value - deposits) at period end
min and max of the daily B minus A difference over the period
number of sessions where B held fewer shares than A
outputs.consistency_check: A_const_state on common / bull_2025 / crash_2026 must equal ladder R1_buyhold exactly: pnl +4,779,819 / +1,154,595 / -124,863; buys 130 / 58 / 7; sells 0; max_dd -7,920,376 / -298,659 / -155,087
outputs.cost_diagnostics: fees and tick cost are reported as labelled diagnostics only; every headline number is after costs
outputs.format: envelope per contract v3 (module allocate_v1, UTC artifact_id, parent_artifact_hashes = [raw, state_results, state_spec, ladder_results] full hashes, availability_status, exchange_session KRX date sessions, decision_at previous_session_close marker, execution_not_before next_session_open marker, value_unit krw / shares declared per field), trade_records (session, side, qty, price, fee, w), daily_records (session, cash, qty, value, deposits, w), metrics
outputs.write: single xb write of the complete payload

verification_required: hand fixture: 5 sessions, w sequence [1, 1, 0.5, 1] -> expected buys, one half-position sell with floored fee, rebuy; exact won values asserted
A_const_state reproduces ladder R1_buyhold on the three overlapping periods to the won
future perturbation: changing O/C/h for sessions > k leaves all trades and marks through session k unchanged

lookup causality: the record used at close i has decision_session == days[i] and predicted_for_session == days[i+1]; no field of session i+1 other than O[i+1] (execution) and C[i+1] (mark) is read before the trade
parent hashes unchanged; selftest passes from the chat folder copy: python -X utf8 work/allocate_v1_20261106/allocate_v1.py selftest
prohibited_in_this_run: choosing a target volatility, band, cap or lambda by looking at results
calling the comparison a profit improvement
interpretation: All four periods were already viewed; the state module itself was specified after the 2026 crash was observed. Exploratory ledger comparison of a de-risking-only sizing rule against full investment. Not evidence of edge.
open_choices_for_bill: weight formula: sd ratio sqrt(h_ref/h) (drafted) vs variance ratio h_ref/h (stronger de-risking)
valuation price for target_qty: O[i+1] open (drafted) vs C[i] close
whether to add R0 deposit-only line for context (not a variant)
